title: Finance Worksheet: Amount of the In-Place Home Resale Re-Inspection Booking Payment
content:
**Calculation.** The standard booking payment on an In-Place Home Resale file is the fees owed on the file, being every charge on the file less every payment, credit and proceeds deduction on it and never less than zero, plus the package's re-inspection fee for the coming visit unless that visit is an included re-inspection, the sum rounded half up to the cent.

Every re-inspection on the file is charged on its date at the visit fee worked out for it, and a re-inspection among the first re-inspections the package includes is credited in full as an included re-inspection, so that its visit fee adds nothing to the booking payment. The coming visit is an included re-inspection when fewer re-inspections are already recorded on the file than the number of re-inspections the package includes.

## Worksheet lines

| Line | Quantity | How it is found |
|---|---|---|
| A | Charges | every charge on the file's ledger |
| B | Payments, credits and proceeds deductions | every payment, credit and proceeds deduction on the file's ledger |
| C | Fees owed | A less B, never less than zero, rounded half up to the cent |
| D | Visit fee of the coming visit | 0.00 if the visit is an included re-inspection; otherwise the package's re-inspection fee, rounded half up to the cent |
| E | Booking payment | C plus D |

## Worked figures (hypothetical files; package re-inspection fee 75.00)

| File | Charges | Payments and credits | Fees owed | Re-inspections already recorded / included | Visit fee | Booking payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 965.00 | 795.00 | 170.00 | 0 / 0 | 75.00 | 245.00 |
| 2 | 965.00 | 795.00 | 170.00 | 0 / 1 | 0.00 (included) | 170.00 |
| 3 | 965.00 | 795.00 | 170.00 | 1 / 1 | 75.00 | 245.00 |
| 4 | 300.00 | 320.00 | 0.00 (never below zero) | 2 / 2 | 75.00 | 75.00 |
